bull.b: Early MYQORZO adoption is broadening across prescribers and patients, with dispensed patients nearly tripling quarter over quarter and new-to-brand share exceeding 40%. This provides an emerging commercial base that can support recurring product revenue as awareness and prescribing expand.

Positive pivotal data in non-obstructive HCM could expand aficamten beyond its current market opportunity and strengthen Cytokinetics’ muscle-focused franchise. The planned sNDA creates a defined regulatory path, while consistent subgroup benefits support broader clinical applicability.

The enlarged cash position gives Cytokinetics greater capacity to fund commercialization, regulatory submissions, and late-stage clinical programs. This reduces immediate financing pressure and provides flexibility to pursue multiple development milestones while MYQORZO revenue is still scaling.

bear.b: Cytokinetics is consuming substantial cash while remaining deeply unprofitable, so continued investment depends on its liquidity and access to financing or future product revenue. Persistent outflows can reduce strategic flexibility and raise the funding required to reach sustainable earnings.

The sharp revenue decline shows that collaboration and milestone payments can materially distort reported results from period to period. Until product revenue becomes large and consistent, earnings visibility may remain weak and financial performance exposed to the timing of external development events.

bear.t: Commercial access friction and rising costs
bear.b: Administrative hurdles are delaying conversion from prescriptions to dispensed patients, which can slow the pace of MYQORZO revenue growth. At the same time, the launch requires substantially higher commercial spending, creating execution pressure before the expanded sales infrastructure produces operating leverage.
